brands.name: Mark Richards Surfboards
brands.short_description: Low-output, high-quality surfboards shaped by four-time world champion Mark Richards in Australia, from history-defining twins to modern shortboards.

models.name: 1980 Retro Pro
models.description: An update on Mark Richards' most popular retro model, the 1980 Retro Twin Fin. It shares a similar retro rocker, vee bottom, fluted wings and thickness distribution, with a narrower nose and a wider more curved tail. Fast, loose, and a blast from the past. Standard fin setup is twin fin plus stabiliser.

models.name: 1979 Retro Single Fin
models.description: Faithfully recreated from an original 1979 board, retaining the same dimensions and plan-shape curves, retro rocker and thickness distribution with a beak nose, and a flat panel V bottom. Set or fin-box options are available using the MR 1979 fin template.

models.name: Super Twin 2
models.description: The most popular and versatile model in the MR range. Mark Richards' ultimate small-wave high-performance board: fast, loose and easy to turn. Wider template with more nose area for flotation and paddling power. Standard fin setup is twin fin plus stabiliser.

models.name: California Twin
models.description: A collaboration between Mark Richards and Matt Biolos. A modern single-to-double concave twin-plus-trailer based on MR's Super Twin, with lower entry rocker, a wider nose and tail block, and extra width for glide in gutless surf.

models.name: Cali Twin Pin
models.description: A natural extension of the California Twin, also designed with Matt Biolos. The winged swallow of the original Cali Twin is replaced with a pin tail while keeping the wide forward outline, low entry rocker and deep single-to-double concave.

models.name: Flying Fish
models.description: A performance fish designed to surf rail to rail while keeping fish planing speed on fat sections and drive in small waves. Full pointed nose, low entry rocker, and a single-to-double concave. Standard fin setup is 5-fin.

models.name: Puffer Twin
models.description: Combines the 1980 Retro Pro Twin with the modern Super Twin and Flying Fish to create a retro high-performance twin. Semi-fish outline with a full pointed nose. Standard fin setup is twin fin plus stabiliser.

models.name: Scalded Cat
models.description: A small-wave board designed through countless prototypes to enhance performance in small, marginal surf. Semi-fish with a full pointed nose and low rocker. Standard fin setup is twin fin plus stabiliser; also available as a 5-fin.

models.name: Mid Length Swallow Twin + 1
models.description: Balances performance and paddle power. Full pointed nose with low entry rocker, and a single-to-double concave with an accentuated V-like spine for acceleration. Developed on 6'8" and 7'0" lengths.

models.name: Bush Ranger Step-Up
models.description: A high-performance step-up for when the surf has some size. Increased nose width and extra thickness under the chest, with accelerated tail rocker. Standard fin setup is 5-fin.

models.name: Bush Ranger Gun
models.description: The go-to board for good 6–8 ft plus surf. A modern gun with maneuverability on the open face that still holds in critical situations. Standard fin setup is thruster.
